Unit Essential Questions
explanation: This slide outlines the Unit Essential Questions for Unit 5, which guide the study of evolution. The three central questions ask: what evidence supports Charles Darwin's Theory of Evolution by Natural Selection as the unifying theory of biology; what factors make natural selection 'natural'; and how natural selection drives both intra-specific (within-species) and inter-specific (between-species) diversity over evolutionary time.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the Unit Essential Questions listed for Unit 5?
opts: What evidence supports the idea that Darwin’s Theory of Evolution by Natural Selection is the “unifying theory of biology”?
How does Natural Selection encourage intra-and inter-specific diversity over time?
How do mutations in DNA cause cancer in somatic cells?
questions.exp: The first three options are the exact essential questions listed on the slide, whereas the fourth option regarding DNA mutations and somatic cell cancer is not mentioned.
